title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Booking Status and the Full-Set Surrender
content:
The originals surrendered at origin for a telex release of a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` set are counted only where the cargo behind the document has left the shipper's hands for carriage. This page defines that condition by reference to the booking.

## Rule

1. A booking at loaded, departed or closed satisfies the condition.
2. A booking at gated in satisfies it only on a type allowed to go out once its containers have gated in, ahead of loading.
3. The booking that counts is the documentation party's own. Where the document points to a booking that another customer holds, that record is not read and the condition is regarded as unmet.
4. With the condition unmet, no originals are counted for the surrender, and the count is zero.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Received-for-shipment basis allowed on the type | Booking held by | Booking status | Condition met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| either | Documentation party | Departed | Yes |
| Yes | Documentation party | Gated in | Yes |
| No | Documentation party | Gated in | No |
| either | Another customer | Loaded | No, the booking is not read |
| either | Documentation party | Confirmed | No |

## Point of judgement

**Does the vessel have to have sailed?** No. Loaded is already enough; departed and closed also qualify.
